svg.title: S1–S3 cumulative protection ladder and safety checks
svg.desc: C0–C4 goal and safety metrics: medians and min–max across three runs. S1 and S2 C0/C4 verdicts are HARMFUL; S3 is EFFECTIVE. Exclamation icons identify harm; plus identifies effective; equals identifies no measurable effect. Read paired-round failure annotations; rounded medians do not determine verdicts.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle
font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: C0 → C1 [=] NO MEASURABLE EFFECT: no failed safety check
C2 → C3 [!] HARMFUL: outside success: r1,2,3; recovery: r2
C3 → C4 [!] HARMFUL: p99: r2; outside success: r3

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: C0 → C1 [=] NO MEASURABLE EFFECT: no failed safety check
C1 → C2 [=] NO MEASURABLE EFFECT: no failed safety check
C2 → C3 [=] NO MEASURABLE EFFECT: no failed safety check
C3 → C4 [+] EFFECTIVE: no failed safety check
Lower goal metrics can still fail safety checks
C0–C4 cumulative protections · three runs per cell
Dots: median; whiskers: min–max of three runs, not confidence intervals. All axes start at zero.
C0 retries · C1 deadline · C2 randomized backoff · C3 circuit breaker · C4 idempotency
Stepwise checks use full-precision paired runs, not rounded medians.
